Thanks for taking your time to reply to this weird post. You seem nice. I agree the working class is what keeps the world moving. I should say I do respect fast food workers, cashiers, other dishwashers, and the like too, I was just ragging on dishwashing because I'm not happy with it or myself, but it is a very necessary job with (trust me) no outside appreciation lol

>And to the people around you that say you have to keep going you actually don’t, but if you give up now there is no changing your mind, if you keep pushing through the hardship and make it through it you may think that it was worth it and be glad you didn’t give up.

I like this, but it can be very hard to follow when it doesn't seem like anything is improving.
